Name: Abigail's New Haircut - Seasonal
Author: SingleMaltWhisky
Description:
[size=3]I felt like Abigail could use a haircut so I gave her one.[/size]

[size=5][b]Install instructions:[/b][/size]
Just copy the folder from the .zip file into your mods folder. Just make sure you also have Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic installed.
This mod basically overwrites Abigail's sprites and portraits of that mod.
